direct.label: Hard to port! Reef ahead!
direct.narrator_line: Sailing Master! Hard to port — reef dead ahead!

direct.label: Hard starboard! Shoal water!
direct.narrator_line: Hard starboard — shoal water on the port bow!

direct.label: Come about! Run before the wind!
direct.narrator_line: Come about! Run before the wind — full ahead!

direct.label: Close-haul! Into the wind!
direct.narrator_line: Close-haul! Take her into the wind!

direct.label: Full sail — all canvas!
direct.narrator_line: Full sail! Every scrap of canvas — move!

direct.label: Reduce to half sail!
direct.narrator_line: Reduce sail to half — we're heeling too far!

direct.label: Strike sail — bare poles!
direct.narrator_line: Strike all sail — bare poles! Storm coming!

direct.label: Port guns — RUN OUT!
direct.narrator_line: Run out the port guns!

direct.label: Port guns — SECURE!
direct.narrator_line: Secure the port guns — lash them down!

direct.label: Starboard guns — READY!
direct.narrator_line: Starboard battery — run them out!

direct.label: Starboard guns — SECURE!
direct.narrator_line: Secure starboard guns!

direct.label: Drop anchor NOW!
direct.narrator_line: Drop anchor! All stop!

direct.label: Bilge pump to MAXIMUM!
direct.narrator_line: Carpenter! Bilge pumps to maximum — we're taking water!

direct.label: Bilge pump to half!
direct.narrator_line: Ease the bilge pump to half — steady now!

direct.label: Bilge pump to minimum!
direct.narrator_line: Cut the bilge pump to minimum — save the arms!

direct.label: Shut the bilge pump!
direct.narrator_line: Carpenter! Shut down the bilge pump!

direct.label: Patch the hull — NOW!
direct.narrator_line: Carpenter! Patch that hole before we sink!

direct.label: Brace the mainmast!
direct.narrator_line: Brace the mainmast — it's cracking!

direct.label: Release mast braces!
direct.narrator_line: Release the mast braces — we need to tack!

direct.label: Tighten keel bolts!
direct.narrator_line: Tighten the keel bolts — she's working loose!

direct.label: Cut the fouled rigging!
direct.narrator_line: Carpenter! Cut that fouled rigging away!

direct.label: Signal lamp to code 88!
direct.narrator_line: Signalman! Flash code eighty-eight — pursuit signal!

direct.label: Signal lamp: code 42!
direct.narrator_line: Signalman! Code forty-two — request assistance!

direct.label: Signal: all-clear code 150!
direct.narrator_line: Signal all-clear — code one-fifty!

direct.label: Emergency signal 200!
direct.narrator_line: Signalman! Emergency — code two hundred!

direct.label: Run up the colours!
direct.narrator_line: Run up the King's colours! Show them who we are!

direct.label: Strike the colours!
direct.narrator_line: Strike the colours — run silent!

direct.label: Sound the fog horn!
direct.narrator_line: Sound the fog horn — warn them off!

direct.label: Silence the fog horn!
direct.narrator_line: Silence that horn — we need stealth!

direct.label: Hail the enemy vessel!
direct.narrator_line: Hail that vessel — demand they strike!

direct.label: Fire a signal flare!
direct.narrator_line: Fire a flare! Mark our position!

direct.label: Unlock the ARMS LOCKER!
direct.narrator_line: Master-at-Arms! Unlock the main arms locker — now!

direct.label: Open the POWDER ROOM!
direct.narrator_line: Open the powder magazine! We need shot!

direct.label: Watch roster — DAY!
direct.narrator_line: Master-at-Arms! Set watch to day roster!

direct.label: Watch roster — BATTLE!
direct.narrator_line: Battle stations! Set the watch to battle!

direct.label: Watch roster — NIGHT!
direct.narrator_line: Night watch! Set the roster — position three!

direct.label: Lock the brig!
direct.narrator_line: Lock the brig — prisoners below!

direct.label: Unlock the brig!
direct.narrator_line: Unlock the brig — all hands needed on deck!

direct.label: Open gun ports!
direct.narrator_line: Open the gun ports!

direct.label: Close gun ports!
direct.narrator_line: Close the gun ports — we're taking spray!

direct.label: Beat to quarters!
direct.narrator_line: Beat to quarters! All hands to battle stations!

direct.label: Mix BLUE remedy!
direct.narrator_line: Surgeon! Mix the blue fever remedy — men are dropping!

direct.label: Mix RED poultice!
direct.narrator_line: Surgeon! Red poultice for the wounded — hurry!

direct.label: Mix GREEN antidote!
direct.narrator_line: Mix the green antidote — possible poisoning!

direct.label: Laudanum dose to 150!
direct.narrator_line: Surgeon! Laudanum to one-fifty — the Captain needs it!

direct.label: Reduce dose to 80!
direct.narrator_line: Ease the dose to eighty — too much and he'll sleep!

direct.label: Emergency dose — 250!
direct.narrator_line: Emergency dose! Crank it to two-fifty — stat!

direct.label: Issue the rum ration!
direct.narrator_line: Issue the rum ration — steady the men's nerves!

direct.label: Cut the rum ration!
direct.narrator_line: Cut the rum — I need clear heads!

direct.label: Check the wounded!
direct.narrator_line: Surgeon! Check on the wounded below!

direct.label: Smelling salts — revive him!
direct.narrator_line: Smelling salts! Revive that man!

direct.label: Chart bearing: 7-2-1!
direct.narrator_line: Cartographer! Plot bearing seven-two-one!

direct.label: Chart code: 4-5-1-9!
direct.narrator_line: Navigation code four-five-one-nine — plot it!

direct.label: Enter bearing 3-0-8!
direct.narrator_line: Cartographer! Bearing three-zero-eight!

direct.label: Glass bearing to 140!
direct.narrator_line: Cartographer! Spyglass bearing to one-forty!

direct.label: Glass bearing to 80!
direct.narrator_line: Bearing eighty — track that sail!

direct.label: Set bearing to 210!
direct.narrator_line: Bearing two-ten — that's the Galleon!

direct.label: Check the tide table!
direct.narrator_line: Check the tide table — is the channel passable?

direct.label: Close the tide table!
direct.narrator_line: Stow the tide table — we've got what we need!

direct.label: Take a star fix!
direct.narrator_line: Star fix! Confirm our position!

direct.label: Log our position!
direct.narrator_line: Log that position in the ship's record!

direct.label: Spyglass bearing 120!
direct.narrator_line: Lookout! Spyglass to bearing one-twenty!

direct.label: Spyglass to 200!
direct.narrator_line: Lookout! Bearing two hundred — what do you see?

direct.label: Sweep to bearing 60!
direct.narrator_line: Sweep to sixty — something on the horizon!

direct.label: Hoist signal flags!
direct.narrator_line: Hoist the signal flags — spread the word!

direct.label: Strike the flags!
direct.narrator_line: Strike the flags — go dark!

direct.label: Eyes to port — NOW!
direct.narrator_line: Lookout! Eyes to port — report what you see!

direct.label: Eyes to starboard!
direct.narrator_line: Starboard watch — scan the horizon!

direct.label: Man the crow's nest!
direct.narrator_line: Up the crow's nest — I need a full view!

direct.label: Orders: PURSUIT!
direct.narrator_line: Bosun! Set orders to pursuit — position one!

direct.label: Orders: BROADSIDE!
direct.narrator_line: Bosun! Broadside formation — position two!

direct.label: Orders: HOLD STATION!
direct.narrator_line: Hold station — position three! Steady as she goes!

direct.label: Orders: RETREAT!
direct.narrator_line: Retreat! Set to position four — fall back!

direct.label: Confirm the order!
direct.narrator_line: Bosun! Confirm that order — pipe it through!

direct.label: Master key — TURN IT!
direct.narrator_line: Turn the master key — unlock the magazine!

direct.label: ALL HANDS ON DECK!
direct.narrator_line: All hands on deck! Every man to his station!

direct.label: Update the ship's log!
direct.narrator_line: Log it! Ship's log — note the engagement!

cooperative.label: Tell Helm: hard to port!
cooperative.narrator_line: Bosun! Tell the Sailing Master — hard to port!

cooperative.label: Tell Helm: run before the wind!
cooperative.narrator_line: Carpenter! Shout to the Helm — run before the wind!

cooperative.label: Tell Carpenter: pump to max!
cooperative.narrator_line: Cartographer! Tell the Carpenter — pumps to maximum!

cooperative.label: Tell Carpenter: pump to half!
cooperative.narrator_line: Bosun! Tell the Carpenter — half pump!

cooperative.label: Tell Signals: code 88!
cooperative.narrator_line: Helm! Tell the Signalman — code eighty-eight!

cooperative.label: Tell Signals: code 42!
cooperative.narrator_line: Lookout! Shout to Signals — code forty-two!

cooperative.label: Tell Arms: lock the brig!
cooperative.narrator_line: Surgeon! Shout to the Master-at-Arms — lock the brig!

cooperative.label: Tell Arms: beat to quarters!
cooperative.narrator_line: Signalman! Tell the Master-at-Arms — beat to quarters!

cooperative.label: Tell Surgeon: issue rum!
cooperative.narrator_line: Carpenter! Tell the Surgeon — issue the rum ration!

cooperative.label: Tell Surgeon: smelling salts!
cooperative.narrator_line: Master-at-Arms! Tell the Surgeon — salts, NOW!

cooperative.label: Tell Charts: bearing 3-0-8!
cooperative.narrator_line: Helm! Tell the Cartographer — bearing three-zero-eight!

cooperative.label: Tell Charts: glass to 160!
cooperative.narrator_line: Bosun! Tell the Cartographer — bearing one-sixty!

cooperative.label: Tell Lookout: glass to 120!
cooperative.narrator_line: Cartographer! Tell the Lookout — bearing one-twenty!

cooperative.label: Tell Lookout: hoist flags!
cooperative.narrator_line: Signalman! Tell the Lookout — hoist the signal flags!

cooperative.label: Tell Bosun: set pursuit!
cooperative.narrator_line: Lookout! Tell the Bosun — switch to pursuit!

cooperative.label: Tell Bosun: turn the key!
cooperative.narrator_line: Surgeon! Shout to the Bosun — turn the master key!

crises.label: BROADSIDE INCOMING!
crises.narrator_line: BROADSIDE! ALL HANDS — BRACE FOR IMPACT!

crises.label: ROGUE WAVE!
crises.narrator_line: ROGUE WAVE! Grab hold — at least four of you! BRACE!

crises.label: FIRE IN THE HOLD!
crises.narrator_line: FIRE IN THE HOLD! Carpenter — pump the bilge! Surgeon — treat the burned! Everyone — buckets!

crises.label: RIGGING SNAPPED!
crises.narrator_line: THE RIGGING'S SNAPPED! Carpenter — brace the mast! Lookout — check the bearing! HOLD FAST!

narrator_lines: Attention all hands. This is your Captain speaking.
The Spanish pirate galleon Sangre Carmesí has been sighted off the southern cape.
She has been preying on merchant convoys for six months. The Admiralty wants her taken.
All hands to stations. We sail to intercept. God save the King.

narrator_lines_ambient: Steady lads. The wind is with us.
Keep those sails trimmed — we need every knot of speed.
The Galleon's been spotted two leagues south-south-east.
Hands to your stations. No slacking.

narrator_lines: Excellent seamanship! We've closed the distance. The Galleon is in sight!
Prepare for engagement. Run out the guns and ready the crew.
Too slow! The Galleon is pulling ahead. She knows we're coming.
We need to sail harder, or we'll lose her in the island chain!

narrator_lines_ambient: The Galleon is turning to fight! Battle with the Spaniards!
Cannons ready! Wait for the order!
She's flying the red flag — no quarter! Stand firm!
Close the distance — I want to see the whites of their eyes!
She's getting away! More sail! MORE SAIL!
A squall is building to the west — this complicates things.
The crew is tiring — keep their spirits up!
We cannot let her reach the open sea! Push through!

narrator_lines: The broadside struck true! The Galleon's mainmast is falling!
She's crippled! Close in for the final engagement — board her!
The pirates returned fire with a vengeance. Our rigging is shredded!
We're limping, but they're wounded too. One last chance — press the attack!
She tried to flee through the strait, but we cut her off!
The Galleon is trapped! All guns — prepare to fire!
She's almost at the open sea. We have one shot at this.
Everything you have! Ram her if you must! England expects!

narrator_lines_ambient: Grappling hooks away! Boarding parties forward!
The pirates are fighting like cornered rats!
Hold the deck! Push them back!
Their captain is on the quarterdeck — take him alive!
Both ships are battered — this is anyone's fight!
Keep firing! Don't let them regroup!
The wind is shifting — use it!
One more broadside and she'll strike her colours!
We've got her cornered! Don't let up now!
She's trying to slip past — block the channel!
Fire at will! Aim for the waterline!
The pirates are panicking — keep the pressure on!
This is our last chance! She must not escape!
The ship is falling apart around us — hold together!
Everything we have — FIRE!
For King and Country! Do not let her go!

narrator_lines: The powder magazine has been struck. A deafening explosion tears through the ship.
His Majesty's vessel breaks apart. The sea claims her and all aboard.
The Sangre Carmesí sails on. England mourns.
The Crimson Galleon strikes her colours! The pirate captain surrenders his sword.
A King's fortune in stolen gold is recovered from her hold.
Textbook naval engagement. The Admiralty will name this one for the history books.
God save the King. Well fought, every man of you.
After a brutal final exchange, the Galleon is captured — but at heavy cost.
She nearly slipped away in that last engagement. But the prize is ours.
The crew will need shore leave after this one. Well done, lads.
A rough middle passage, but you found your sea legs when it mattered.
The Galleon is taken. Her crew is in irons below decks.
Lost some good timber in the process, but the mission is accomplished. Good recovery.
The Galleon escapes into open water, but we've wounded her badly.
She won't be raiding convoys for months. A partial victory at best.
That started so promising. What went wrong, gentlemen?
What a pursuit! A terrible start — but the crew rallied magnificently.
The pirates are captured and their vessel seized as a prize.
From the jaws of failure, you snatched victory. The Admiralty is impressed.
Both ships limp into port. The Galleon is too damaged to flee, but we're no better.
The pirates are captured, but barely. A pyrrhic victory.
Inconsistency nearly cost us everything today.
A miracle at the last. One desperate broadside brought down her colours.
The ship is barely afloat. Half the crew is wounded. But the Galleon is ours.
Do not count on Divine Providence twice, gentlemen.
The Sangre Carmesí disappears beyond the horizon. Gone.
His Majesty's ship limps home in disgrace. The Admiralty will not be pleased.
Six months of piracy will continue. The convoys will burn. You have failed.

between_commands_lines: Time and tide wait for no man!
That's an order from the Captain!
England expects every man to do his duty!
